name: property_as_constraint1.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (a1 Ref)(a2 Ref)(e1 Ref)(e2 Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Angle (mk-Angle (value Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Event (mk-Event (t1 Real)(t2 Real)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-Angle (sel-Angle Angle))
  (lift-Event (sel-Event Event))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Angle ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Angle (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Angle ((this Ref)) Angle
  (sel-Angle (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Event ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Event (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Event ((this Ref)) Event
  (sel-Event (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Angle ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Angle this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Event ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Event this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.a1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!a1 ((this Ref)) Ref
  (a1 (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.a2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!a2 ((this Ref)) Ref
  (a2 (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.e1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!e1 ((this Ref)) Ref
  (e1 (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.e2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!e2 ((this Ref)) Ref
  (e2 (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ----------------------------
;   Getters for class Angle:
; ----------------------------

; --- getters for Angle.value: ---

(define-fun Angle.value ((this Ref)) Int
  (value (deref-Angle this))
)

(define-fun Angle!value ((this Ref)) Int
  (value (deref-Angle this))
)

; ----------------------------
;   Getters for class Event:
; ----------------------------

; --- getters for Event.t1: ---

(define-fun Event.t1 ((this Ref)) Real
  (t1 (deref-Event this))
)

(define-fun Event!t1 ((this Ref)) Real
  (t1 (deref-Event this))
)

; --- getters for Event.t2: ---

(define-fun Event.t2 ((this Ref)) Real
  (t2 (deref-Event this))
)

(define-fun Event!t2 ((this Ref)) Real
  (t2 (deref-Event this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ----------------------------
;   Methods for class Angle:
; ----------------------------

(define-fun Angle.eq ((this Ref)(other Ref)) Bool
  (= (Angle.value this) (Angle.value other))
)

(define-fun Angle!eq ((this Ref)(other Ref)) Bool
  (= (Angle!value this) (Angle.value other))
)

; ----------------------------
;   Methods for class Event:
; ----------------------------

(define-fun Event.equal ((this Ref)(e Ref)) Bool
  (and (= (Event.t1 this) (Event.t1 e)) (= (Event.t2 this) (Event.t2 e)))
)

(define-fun Event!equal ((this Ref)(e Ref)) Bool
  (and (= (Event!t1 this) (Event.t1 e)) (= (Event!t2 this) (Event.t2 e)))
)

(define-fun Event.meets ((this Ref)(e Ref)) Bool
  (= (Event.t2 this) (Event.t1 e))
)

(define-fun Event!meets ((this Ref)(e Ref)) Bool
  (= (Event!t2 this) (Event.t1 e))
)

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Angle (TopLevelDeclarations!a1 this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Angle (TopLevelDeclarations!a2 this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 0) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Event (TopLevelDeclarations!e1 this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 0) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Event (TopLevelDeclarations!e2 this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 0) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (Angle.eq (TopLevelDeclarations!a1 this) (TopLevelDeclarations!a2 this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv5 0) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 6: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv6 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (Event.meets (TopLevelDeclarations!e1 this) (TopLevelDeclarations!e2 this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv6 0) :named _xkassert5))



; ------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Angle:
; ------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-Angle Angle)
(declare-const const-2-Angle Angle)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Angle.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (and (>= (Angle!value this) 0) (<= (Angle!value this) 360))
)

(assert (! (Angle.inv1 1) :named _xkassert6))
(assert (! (Angle.inv1 2) :named _xkassert7))



; ------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Event:
; ------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-Event Event)
(declare-const const-4-Event Event)




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-Angle const-1-Angle))
        2 (lift-Angle const-2-Angle))
        3 (lift-Event const-3-Event))
        4 (lift-Event const-4-Event))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-3-Event () Event
  (mk-Event 2.0 3.0))
(define-fun const-2-Angle () Angle
  (mk-Angle 138))
(define-fun const-1-Angle () Angle
  (mk-Angle 0))
(define-fun const-4-Event () Event
  (mk-Event 4.0 4.0))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1 1 4 4))
(define-fun _xkassert7 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (>= (value (sel-Angle (select heap 2))) 0))
      (a!2 (<= (value (sel-Angle (select heap 2))) 360)))
  (and a!1 a!2)))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (e1 (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-Event a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (e1 (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0)))))
      (a!2 (select heap (e2 (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (= (t2 (sel-Event a!1)) (t1 (sel-Event a!2)))))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (a1 (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-Angle a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (e2 (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-Event a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (>= (value (sel-Angle (select heap 1))) 0))
      (a!2 (<= (value (sel-Angle (select heap 1))) 360)))
  (and a!1 a!2)))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (a2 (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-Angle a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (a1 (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0)))))
      (a!2 (select heap (a2 (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (= (value (sel-Angle a!1)) (value (sel-Angle a!2)))))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         0
                         (lift-TopLevelDeclarations
                           (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1 1 4 4)))
                  1
                  (lift-Angle (mk-Angle 0)))))
(let ((a!2 (store (store a!1 2 (lift-Angle (mk-Angle 138)))
                  3
                  (lift-Event (mk-Event 2.0 3.0)))))
  (store a!2 4 (lift-Event (mk-Event 4.0 4.0))))))
